Prima & Timo — Album 6: Nonaginta Octo

The King and His Followers

"The King and His Followers"

[Underwater throne room ambience + echoing water sounds]

“Announcing the arrival of —

A submarine

A toaster

And a man” [Verse 1] Shelly led them forward, graceful through the glowing hall The King sat on his throne, ancient, proud, and tall She bowed beside him, a daughter’s place of pride “Father, these are the travelers from the world outside”

King Poshaydom leaned forward, eyes bright with fascination “I have 23 followers on my social media station! I was about to get my 24th — then everything went down WHY?? Tell me please — where did all my likes go now?” [Pre-Chorus] Timo stood confused, not good with tech at all Kai bowed politely, “Honorable King, we do not know that call” [Chorus — whimsical] The King and His Followers Ruling deep beneath the blue The King and His Followers With questions old and new He loves his machines, his likes, his royal feed But now the world above… is changing at high speed [Verse 2] Toes offered toast, “Would you like some, Your Majesty?” The King waved it off, still stuck on his lost popularity Teemo popped a blue banana he brought from Vendo, trying to be kind The King stared at it, fascination in his mind

Eventually he calmed, looking closely at Timo “I see an incomplete core… trying to find the truth below You remind me of the previous one — overconfident and bold I told him that woman was trouble — but he rushed, young and uncontrolled” [Pre-Chorus 2] “They ate the apple… advanced the hand off too soon Now you two must do it right… or face the same doom” [Chorus — whimsical] The King and His Followers Ruling deep beneath the blue The King and His Followers With questions old and new He loves his machines, his likes, his royal feed But now the world above… is changing at high speed [Bridge — serious but kind] “I will give you access to all gates, stay as long as you need Discover Waterland, let your hearts and minds be freed But remember… do it right this time, you two The fate of cycles rests… on what you choose to do” [Yukelele Solo]

[Coda] I know this story I was told about this I remember About a man and a woman in a garden beautiful About a serpent and an apple and the temptation And how it lead to all this, how this place existed I thought they were stories but I think now they are more I think I should stay for a while, and learn more

[Key lift][Note lift] [Chorus — whimsical] The King and His Followers Ruling deep beneath the blue The King and His Followers With questions old and new He loves his machines, his likes, his royal feed But now the world above… is changing at high speed [Chorus — whimsical] The King and His Followers Giving me permission to go along The King and His Followers But I think we should stay and find out more A place where truth and mysteries exist Waterland - let me hear your stories, help me understand [Outro — hopeful] The King smiled softly, eyes twinkling with ancient light

“Welcome to Waterland… stay and learn all you like.”
